name: Twisted Fate - Gambler
texts: When I attack, reveal the top rune of your rune deck, then recycle it. Do one of the following based on its domain::rb_rune_fury: — Deal 2 to an enemy unit here and 1 to all other enemy units here. :rb_rune_mind: — Draw 1. :rb_rune_order: — Stun an enemy unit.
manual: When I attack, reveal the top rune of your rune deck, then recycle it.
Do one of the following based on its domain::rb_rune_fury: — Deal 2 to an enemy unit here and 1 to all other enemy units here.
